newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific Nickel share trading suspended.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Nickel share trading suspended.

text.p: Trading of shares in Pacific Nickel Ltd was suspended on Tuesday at the company's request pending an announcement, the Australian Stock Exchange said.
Pacific Nickel said in a statement that discussions had started with other participants in the Nonoc nickel project in the Philippines with a view to restructuring interests in the project.
It also said it had been advised that an option to buy Pacific Nickel Holdings Ltd, giving it control of the Nonoc mine, would not be extended beyond the current expiry date of September 1.
Pacific Nickel, formerly Arboyne NL, holds an option to acquire Pacific Nickel Holdings, which together with a Philippine affiliate, controls Nonoc.
Nonoc has been closed since 1986 after falling victim to high local currency exchange rates and low metal prices.
The Philippine government entered into an agreement with Pacific Nickel in July 1996 to take over the project.
